user.title: Health Monitor
user.description: Select the template sensor that should be generated and kept in sync.

options.title: Health Monitor – Monitors
options.description: {rows} monitors configured. Choose an action: generate the template, add, edit or delete monitors – or quick-add from an integration. Rows with the same name are merged into one monitor.

row.title: Monitor: {name}
row.description: Field help: entry = config entry UUIDs (comma separated); rep = representative entity (availability check); plug = power switch (off = never flagged); check = entity, entity|bad1,bad2 or entity|bad|text; fresh = entity or entity|hours.

delete.title: Delete monitors
delete.description: Select the monitors to remove from the table.

quick_add.title: Quick add: {domain}
quick_add.description: Select entities to add as monitors (one row per entity).

refresh.name: Refresh status
refresh.description: Recompute the sync status of the generated template.

resync.name: Resync template
resync.description: Regenerate the template from the table and write it to the target helper.
